title: A Clash of Kings
tagline: Five kings enter, mostly poison and shadow babies exit.
summary: Five different men declare themselves King because Roberts brothers have the combined interpersonal skills of a wet badger. Renly brings peach-flavored charisma and 100,000 soldiers, so Stannis counters by having a red priestess birth a literal shadow assassin out of her womb to shank him in a tent. In King's Landing, Tyrion saves the entire city from Stannis using green fire and a giant boom chain, and his reward is getting his nose sliced in half and his father telling him he's a biological mistake. Daenerys walks into the House of the Undying and witnesses 80 different prophecies that George has spent the last 28 years trying to untangle.
flagrantPlotHoles: Shadow Assassins are overpowered: If Melisandre can birth a ghost dagger to execute Renly and Penrose, why didn't she just mail one to Tywin, Joffrey, and the Mountain?
The Great Ranging Logistics: Jeor Mormont took 300 Night's Watch crows past the Wall into sub-zero blizzard terrain without a supply line, food depots, or winter coats, purely on vibes.
Theon's Winterfell Conquest: Theon seized the capital of the largest kingdom in the continent with literally twenty Ironborn pirates.
georgesExcuse: Look, the shadow baby had a cooldown timer. It's in the patch notes.
